name: ENCE Energía y Celulosa, S.A.
summary: ENCE Energía y Celulosa, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells hardwood pulp and renewable energy in Spain, Germany, Poland, Italy, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Greece, France, Turkey, and internationally. It operates through Cellulose, Forest Heritage and others segments. The company offers bleached eucalyptus kraft pulp; and forest land management and forestry services, as well as producing renewable energy using agricultural and forestry biomass sources; and producing timber for pulp. In addition, it is involved in generating, selling electric energy and carbon credits; developing biogas plants; selling of biomass; clean energy management; gas trading; research …
